title: A clearer video library
body: Find the add-video action and your account more easily, open explanations for DB, SD and HU, and identify divers more clearly in the community library. Browse thumbnails without repeated video-status badges or unnecessary counters. Community and member profiles are more compact, with a clear Message button, a plain membership date, and cleaner preview tiles for dives without a thumbnail. Member cards show the number and latest date of dives you can access.
